response.overview: Guilty Victim is an urban crime drama that follows Jackie, a street-smart investor with deep ties to the underworld, who puts money into a home security company expecting clean returns. When the owner, Milo, falls behind on what he owes, Jackie steps in to handle business, only to realize things have gotten way out of hand. As Milo's scheme starts to fall apart, Jackie finds himself caught between loyalty to his family and protecting his name. With betrayal, stolen money, and people getting hurt, Jackie is forced to choose between saving the people he loves or letting the streets take it all away.
response.title: Guilty Victim
